title: Wake Island Waterpark
specs: First floating pickleball court in the United States
Cable wakeboarding with rental equipment and Pro Model board upgrades
Children under 48" must be accompanied by an adult on stand up paddleboards
Children under 12 may not be left at the park unless accompanied by someone 16 or older
Cable wakeboarding: ages 7-9 must start with beginner lesson or Kids Camp before main cable
Life vest must be US Coast Guard Approved if brought by guest
Waiver required for all participants; parents or legal guardians must sign for children
Floating pickleball court rental includes 4 guests, add up to 4 more for $25 each, max 8 guests
Birthday party packages include 10 activity tickets and 10 standard beach tickets, additional guests can be added
includes: Basic sandal strap wakeboard, helmet and CGA lifejacket included with cable passes for beginners
Life jackets provided for all water activities except wakeboarding with own gear
Aqua Socks provided for floating pickleball court participants
Use of floating cabana during pickleball court rental
gap: Exact age minimum for some activities not stated
blurb: Guests can enjoy the nation's largest floating obstacle course, a Ninja Course, Hamster Wheels, a Zipline, and the Zoom Floom slide. The park offers cable wakeboarding with equipment rental, a floating pickleball court, and birthday party packages. Activities are suitable for various ages with some restrictions and require online booking.
